evals.name: quicklook-swiftui-preview-modifier
evals.prompt: Create a SwiftUI view that displays a file list and presents full-screen document previews using the .quickLookPreview modifier bound to a local file URL.
evals.expected_output: A SwiftUI view binding an optional local URL to .quickLookPreview, ensuring remote URLs are not passed directly.
assertions: Binds to an optional local URL state property.
Ensures target files are verified as local file URLs before passing to the modifier.
Handles dismiss and state reset cleanly.

evals.name: quicklook-preview-controller-data-source
evals.prompt: Implement a QLPreviewController wrapper in Swift conforming to QLPreviewControllerDataSource and QLPreviewControllerDelegate to support paging through a multi-file collection with custom titles.
evals.expected_output: A coordinator or controller implementing numberOfPreviewItems(in:) and previewController(_:previewItemAt:) returning custom QLPreviewItem models.
assertions: Implements previewController(_:previewItemAt:) returning QLPreviewItem conforming items.
Provides custom preview titles via QLPreviewItem conformance.

evals.name: quicklook-thumbnail-generator-request
evals.prompt: Write an asynchronous thumbnail loader using QLThumbnailGenerator that takes a file URL, target point size, and display scale, generates a best representation, and caches it with NSCache.
evals.expected_output: A Swift actor or class using QLThumbnailGenerator.Request and generateBestRepresentation(for:) with NSCache storage.
assertions: Initializes a QLThumbnailGenerator.Request specifying file URL, size, and display scale.
Caches generated UIImage instances in NSCache to avoid re-generating thumbnails.
Runs thumbnail generation off the main thread.

evals.name: quicklook-remote-download-preview-lifecycle
evals.prompt: Show how to safely preview a remote document (e.g. from an HTTPS URL) using QuickLook, including downloading to a temporary directory, presenting the preview, and cleaning up the temp file on dismissal.
evals.expected_output: A complete download-preview-teardown workflow ensuring remote URLs are saved locally before QL previewing and deleted after presentation.
assertions: Downloads remote data or downloads file using URLSession before opening QuickLook.
Stores the file at a temporary local file URL.
Opens QuickLook preview using the local file URL.
Cleans up the temporary file when preview is dismissed.
